description.zh: 一站式查看、安装、卸载、升级 Scoop 与 WinGet 软件包：先查询，选中精确身份后再审阅计划并确认；不自动同意协议、不自行提权、不自动安装包管理器
description.en: Query, install, uninstall and upgrade Scoop and WinGet packages in one window: query first, then review a plan for the exact identity you selected; never auto-accepts agreements, never elevates on its own, never installs a package manager

hint.zh: Enter 打开软件包窗口：已安装 / 发现 / 更新 / 任务
hint.en: Enter opens the Packages window: Installed / Discover / Updates / Tasks

hint.zh: 输入 packages 加空格后搜索包名；Enter 打开窗口
hint.en: Type packages then a space to search packages; Enter opens the window

hint.zh: 只打开窗口并显示已有缓存，不查询 WinGet / Scoop；适合只想看上次结果
hint.en: Opens the window with the existing cache only; WinGet / Scoop are not queried

hint.zh: 打开窗口并立即强制重新查询 WinGet / Scoop，忽略缓存新鲜度
hint.en: Opens the window and forces a fresh WinGet / Scoop query, ignoring the cache's freshness

hint.zh: 跟随 Win顺，或固定中文 / 英文；已打开的窗口会立即切换
hint.en: Follow WinShun, or pin Chinese / English; open windows switch at once

hint.zh: WinGet list 里没有安装记录的项目（observed）默认显示，但不会显示为 managed，也不开放卸载
hint.en: Rows WinGet list enumerates without an install record (observed) stay visible by default, but are never shown as managed and never allow uninstall

hint.zh: 超过该时间未有成功查询时，列表标记为 stale；不会在后台自动查询或安装
hint.en: The list is marked stale once this much time passes without a successful query; nothing is queried or installed in the background

title.zh: 选中后自动获取包信息

hint.zh: 选中 WinGet 行时后台运行 winget show，结果按刷新间隔缓存到插件数据文件夹；关闭后仅在点「更多…」或「官网 / 项目页」时查询
hint.en: Selecting a WinGet row runs winget show in the background and caches the answer in the data folder for the refresh interval; off, only the More and Project page buttons query

hint.zh: 决定打开软件包窗口时是否查询 WinGet / Scoop；「缓存过期时」只在列表超过刷新间隔没成功查询过才扫描
hint.en: Decides whether opening the Packages window queries WinGet / Scoop; 'when the cache is stale' scans only when the list has not been queried successfully within the refresh interval

hint.zh: 插件按需启动后查询一次 WinGet / Scoop，不弹出窗口；不代表随 Win顺 开机预加载。扫描使用普通用户权限。
hint.en: Queries WinGet / Scoop once after the lazy plugin starts, without opening a window. This does not preload it at WinShun startup. Scanning uses ordinary user rights.

hint.zh: 只写入脱敏后的阶段、退出码与错误片段；不含环境全量、令牌或完整个人路径
hint.en: Writes redacted phases, exit codes and error fragments only; no full environment, tokens or complete personal paths
